sections.title: Triforce Charts
sections.note: Tap once for the chart, again once Tingle has deciphered it. The shards are in Main Quest.

items.name: Triforce Chart 1
items.notes: Leads to Triforce Shard 1 at Greatfish Isle (in Main Quest). Still a chart in Wind Waker HD, which keeps three.

tiers.name: Chart found
tiers.howTo: Sink the warship blocking the islet's entrance, go in and conduct the Wind's Requiem on the Wind Waker symbol.

tiers.name: Deciphered
tiers.howTo: Pay Tingle 398 Rupees on Tingle Island to decipher it.

items.name: Triforce Chart 2
items.notes: Leads to Triforce Shard 2 at Gale Isle (in Main Quest). Wind Waker HD has no chart here: the shard itself is in its place.

tiers.name: Chart found
tiers.howTo: Get the Cabana Deed from Mrs. Marie (20 Joy Pendants), then in Mrs. Marie's Cabana pull the lever above the fireplace with the Grappling Hook and crawl through the maze under the chimney.

tiers.name: Deciphered
tiers.howTo: Pay Tingle 398 Rupees on Tingle Island to decipher it.

items.name: Triforce Chart 3
items.notes: Leads to Triforce Shard 3 at Stone Watcher Island (in Main Quest). Still a chart in Wind Waker HD, which keeps three.

tiers.name: Chart found
tiers.howTo: Feed a Hyoi Pear to a seagull and fly it into the switches in the Kargarocs' nests to open the way in.

tiers.name: Deciphered
tiers.howTo: Pay Tingle 398 Rupees on Tingle Island to decipher it.

items.name: Triforce Chart 4
items.notes: Leads to Triforce Shard 4 at Outset Island (in Main Quest). Wind Waker HD has no chart here: the shard itself is in its place.

tiers.name: Chart found
tiers.howTo: Get the Ghost Ship Chart from Diamond Steppe Island, find the ship at night where the chart shows it for that moon phase, and defeat the enemies inside.

tiers.name: Deciphered
tiers.howTo: Pay Tingle 398 Rupees on Tingle Island to decipher it.

items.name: Triforce Chart 5
items.notes: Leads to Triforce Shard 5 at Cliff Plateau Isles (in Main Quest). Still a chart in Wind Waker HD, which keeps three.

tiers.name: Chart found
tiers.howTo: Sink the golden warship by the island with the cannon and salvage what it leaves.

tiers.name: Deciphered
tiers.howTo: Pay Tingle 398 Rupees on Tingle Island to decipher it.

items.name: Triforce Chart 6
items.notes: Leads to Triforce Shard 6 at Southern Triangle Island (in Main Quest). Wind Waker HD has no chart here: the shard itself is in its place.

tiers.name: Chart found
tiers.howTo: Clear floor 30 of the Savage Labyrinth (lift the stone head on the hill with the Power Bracelets) and conduct the Wind's Requiem on the symbol there.

tiers.name: Deciphered
tiers.howTo: Pay Tingle 398 Rupees on Tingle Island to decipher it.

items.name: Triforce Chart 7
items.notes: Leads to Triforce Shard 7 at Seven-Star Isles (in Main Quest). Wind Waker HD has no chart here: the shard itself is in its place.

tiers.name: Chart found
tiers.howTo: Lift the stone head with the Power Bracelets and defeat the enemies in the cave below.

tiers.name: Deciphered
tiers.howTo: Pay Tingle 398 Rupees on Tingle Island to decipher it.

items.name: Triforce Chart 8
items.notes: Leads to Triforce Shard 8 at Two-Eye Reef (in Main Quest). Wind Waker HD has no chart here: the shard itself is in its place.

tiers.name: Chart found
tiers.howTo: Hookshot up to the island and defeat the enemies in its secret cave.

tiers.name: Deciphered
tiers.howTo: Pay Tingle 398 Rupees on Tingle Island to decipher it.

items.name: Tingle's Chart
items.howTo: Tingle gives it to Link for letting him out of jail.
items.notes: Shows Tingle Island and two Great Fairies.

items.name: Beedle's Chart
items.howTo: Arrives by post once Link has the Bombs.
items.notes: Shows Beedle's shop ships, including the masked one.

items.name: IN-credible Chart
items.howTo: Tingle posts it after Aryll is rescued; pay 201 Rupees to read it.
items.notes: Shows where the eight Triforce Charts are.

items.name: Island Hearts Chart
items.notes: Shows the Pieces of Heart on islands.

items.name: Sea Hearts Chart
items.notes: Shows the Pieces of Heart under the sea.

items.name: Great Fairy Chart
items.notes: Shows the Great Fairies.

items.name: Secret Cave Chart
items.notes: Shows the secret caves.

items.name: Light Ring Chart
items.notes: Shows the rings of light that appear under a full moon.

items.name: Octo Chart
items.notes: Shows the Big Octos and their eyes.

items.name: Platform Chart
items.howTo: Defeat the Wizzrobes in the submarine near the platform.
items.notes: Shows the lookout platforms.

items.name: Submarine Chart
items.howTo: In the Boating Course's secret cave: hit its three switches at once.
items.notes: Shows the submarines.

items.name: Ghost Ship Chart
items.howTo: At the end of the warp pot maze inside the island; Hookshot up to its entrance.
items.notes: Shows where the Ghost Ship is by moon phase.
